best: [reel/ur] ویب بلڈر کے ساتھ بزنس کو آگے بڑھائیں - Web Builder (business mobile phone shop, views 274, eng 3, x3.76)
[reel/ur] ویب بلڈر: اسٹور کو جدید اور منافع بخش بنائیں (business beauty salon, views 259, eng 3, x3.60)
[reel/ar] ارتقِ بمتجرك مع ويب بيلدر (business cafe, views 191, eng 4, x3.13)
summary: Pichle teen hafton mein Urdu aur Arabic reels (jaise mobile shop, cafe aur jewellery) bohat zabardast chal rahi hain aur log in par acha response de rahe hain. English ki long videos aur static pictures bilkul nahi chal rahi, khaas kar restaurants aur travel agencies ke liye zero views aaye hain. Isliye agent ne English content kam karke Urdu aur Arabic reels par focus barha diya hai aur har post mein WhatsApp par rabta karne ka kaha hai taake mazeed sales leads mil sakein.

tips: Focus script writing on high-performing business types like mobile phone shops, cafes, and jewellery shops, while completely avoiding low-performing ones like restaurants, travel agencies, and electronics shops.
Produce more Urdu and Arabic video content as they heavily outperform English, which had multiple zero-view failures.
Prioritize Reels over long promo videos and static pictures, focusing on high-engagement localized titles that highlight digital transformation and business growth.
Always use strong visual hooks featuring actual shop environments (like beauty salons and pharmacies) rather than abstract or generic graphics.
End every script with a direct call to action to message on WhatsApp for business solutions, strictly omitting any mention of prices.
